C-17 was waived by the owner, not satisfied; no human screen-reader walkthrough exists. Open obligations block eligibility regardless of the green suite, completed captures, owner fidelity acceptance, or another role's verdict. Earlier verification passes are retained as historical evidence; pass-6 is the current described-build assessment, not a substitute for this review. This conclusion is NEEDS WORK, not final acceptance.
